The top dial is a barometer with a white face, black numerical scale (likely inches of mercury), and a central pointer. The bottom dial appears to be a thermometer or hygrometer with a brass/gold-toned face. The casing is polished wood with elaborate carved floral/scrollwork details at the top and bottom corners.
